rationale: Class (a): the forwarder was never gone. launchd (io.ai-sdlc.webhook-forward, AISDLC-1207) restarted it as pid 64697 after the pre-launchd pid 18081 died at 18:56Z; webhook.json still recorded that pid, so the health check tested a dead pid while events kept arriving (last event 0m). Planner re-recorded the feed with the launchd label (webhook up --feed gh-forward --feed-pid 64697 --feed-agent io.ai-sdlc.webhook-forward), a local board write; no GitHub hook or forwarder restart. Health reads healthy at 19:55Z.
